source: Original deterministic procedural synthesis; no samples or music.

sounds.label: Ataque al aire 1
sounds.trigger: Accepted player attack, including misses.

sounds.label: Impacto en enemigo 1
sounds.trigger: Successful nonlethal hit; alternate variants.

sounds.label: Ataque al aire 2
sounds.trigger: Accepted player attack, including misses.

sounds.label: Impacto en enemigo 2
sounds.trigger: Successful nonlethal hit; alternate variants.

sounds.label: Ataque al aire 3
sounds.trigger: Accepted player attack, including misses.

sounds.label: Impacto en enemigo 3
sounds.trigger: Successful nonlethal hit; alternate variants.

sounds.label: Impacto fuerte
sounds.trigger: Successful hit during boss recovery; replaces ordinary impact.

sounds.label: Esquiva
sounds.trigger: Accepted dodge, never on a cooldown-rejected input.

sounds.label: Daño recibido
sounds.trigger: Player takes damage; honor invulnerability interval.

sounds.label: Enemigo derrotado
sounds.trigger: Enemy dies; replace ordinary impact for that target.

sounds.label: Disparo enemigo
sounds.trigger: Once per volley, not once per projectile.

sounds.label: Aviso de veneno
sounds.trigger: Once when poison telegraph appears, 1.25 seconds before activation.

sounds.label: Veneno activo
sounds.trigger: Once when a pool delay crosses zero, never every update.

sounds.label: Aviso de rayo
sounds.trigger: Once per beam volley at telegraph start; 1.15-second lead time.

sounds.label: Descarga del rayo
sounds.trigger: Once when beam delay crosses zero.

sounds.label: Golpe contra escudo
sounds.trigger: Attack blocked by the host shield; not a successful hit.

sounds.label: Emisor destruido
sounds.trigger: Generator dies; replaces ordinary enemy death.

sounds.label: Escudo desactivado
sounds.trigger: Last living generator destroyed; once per shield phase.

sounds.label: Entrada de jefe
sounds.trigger: Once per boss encounter, not both announcement and spawn.

sounds.label: Preparación de embestida
sounds.trigger: Butcher enters windup, 1.1 seconds before charge.

sounds.label: Embestida
sounds.trigger: Butcher transitions from windup to charge.

sounds.label: Jefe vulnerable
sounds.trigger: Butcher stops charging and enters recovery.

sounds.label: Cambio de reglas
sounds.trigger: Host reaches half health and restores shield; once.

sounds.label: Botiquín
sounds.trigger: Pickup collected; do not duplicate during floor reset.

sounds.label: Confirmación
sounds.trigger: One activation per menu button, not pointerdown plus click.

sounds.label: Mejora elegida
sounds.trigger: Successful upgrade selection; replaces generic confirmation.

sounds.label: Inicio de piso
sounds.trigger: Floor starts or restarts; delay if overlapping upgrade selection.

sounds.label: Señal interrumpida
sounds.trigger: Lethal player damage; replaces ordinary hurt.

sounds.label: Reintento
sounds.trigger: Retry confirmation; sequence before floor start.

sounds.label: Jefe derrotado
sounds.trigger: Boss death; replaces generic kill, no musical fanfare.

sounds.label: Fin del espectáculo
sounds.trigger: Final victory: use instead of boss_defeat, not on top of it.
